description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'UserServiceTest' for testing the 'UserService' class within the OrangeHRM administrative system. It includes setup, mock object creation, and multiple test methods that verify the behavior of user management functionalities such as saving users, password verification, credential retrieval, and undeletable user ID determination.

classes.name: UserServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the functionalities of the 'UserService' class, including user saving, password checks, and credential validations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the 'UserService' object before each test.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Creates and returns a 'UserRole' object with default admin role properties.

methods.name: testSaveSystemUserNoPasswordChange
methods.description: Tests saving a user without changing the password; expects the user object to be returned as is.

methods.name: testSaveSystemUserWithPasswordChange
methods.description: Tests saving a user after setting a new plaintext password, verifying it is hashed before saving.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordUserNotFound
methods.description: Verifies that the method returns false when the user is not found in the database.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordTrue
methods.description: Checks that the current password verification returns true for a matching password.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordWithNullPassword
methods.description: Verifies behavior when the user has no stored password.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordOldHash
methods.description: Tests password verification when the stored password uses an md5 hash, ensuring old hashes are verifiable.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordFalse
methods.description: Ensures verification returns false when the password does not match.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsUserNotFound
methods.description: Checks that null is returned when a user credentials do not match any existing user.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsValidPassword
methods.description: Verifies correct user object is returned when the credentials match and password verification succeeds.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsOldHash
methods.description: Tests migration from an old md5 password hash to a new hashed password during credential validation.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsInvalidPassword
methods.description: Verifies that null is returned if the password verification fails.

methods.name: testGetUndeletableUserIds
methods.description: Tests that the method returns ids of users that are undeletable based on role management, with mock role retrieval.
